withBbd.title: Clearance Deal: Anchor ImmunoHalo Kids Nutritional Milk Powder 900g (Dented Can, Product Intact)
withBbd.bodyHtml:
Clearance: Dented Can, Product Intact

General Information

Anchor Immunohalo Kids 4-13+ Years 900g Can

Warnings

Not suitable as a complete milk food for children under 2 years. Contains Milk, Fish and Soy

Common Uses

Maintaining and supporting a healthy immune system is more important now than ever. Anchor™ lmmunoHalo™ fortified milk powder blend has been specifically developed by Kiwi scientists with Zinc, Iron, Vitamin A, Vitamin C, Vitamin B12 and Vitamin D to help support a healthy immune system in children 4-9+ years. Along with a unique bundle of Probiotics DR10™, Prebiotics, Lactoferrin plus Vitamin B2, Vitamin E, Phosphorus and Calcium. With a hint of Vanilla flavour and the goodness of dairy it tastes delicious! Plus it's easy to add Anchor™ lmmunoHalo™ into your child's daily routine just mix it with water, and milk or get creative with a smoothie and other delicious recipe ideas.

Ingredients

Milk solids (Skim milk powder, Whey powder, Lactoferrin), Glucose Syrup Solids, Prebiotics (fructo-oligosaccharides), Minerals (Calcium, Iron, Zinc), Docosahexaenoic Acid (from refined tuna oil (fish)), Flavours, Probiotics (Bifidobacterium lactis (DR10™)), Vitamins (Vitamin C, E, A, D3, B2, B12), Emulsifier (Soy lecithin).

Directions

Mix 3 tablespoons (35 g) in 3/4 cup (180mL) of drinking water, mix thoroughly with a fork, small whisk, or blender. Milk can be served warm, but not overheated (less than 45°C), to protect the probiotic DR10™ ingredient.

withBbd.title: Anmum Gold PediaPro 3 Toddler Milk Powder 900g X 6 Can (12-36 months)
withBbd.bodyHtml:
From 12 months, your toddler’s an active little person – playing, exploring and getting up to mischief. So we’ve developed Anmum PediaPro3 Toddler Milk, with no added sugars, only lactose, the sugar found naturally in milk. Made right here in New Zealand, it's designed to complement what toddlers eat during the day. Probiotic DR10™, prebiotics, as well as essential vitamins and minerals, provide nutritional support for their active bodies and minds.

The role of a formulated supplementary food for young children is to supplement a normal eating plan to address situations where intakes of energy and nutrients may not be adequate to meet an individual’s requirements.


Directions:
1-3 years: 200ml boiled water, 4 level scoops, 2 times per day


Ingredients:
Milk solids (Whole milk powder, Skim milk powder) Fructo-oligosaccharides, Reduced fat cream powder, Docosahexaenoic acid (from refined tuna oil (fish)), Emulsifier (soy lecithin), Bifidobacterium lactis (DR10™), Minerals: Iron, Zinc, Iodine. Vitamins: Vitamins (A, B1, B3, B6, B12, C, E, D3), Folic acid. 


Warnings:

Contains Milk, Fish and Soy.

Incorrect preparation of formula can make your toddler sick. Follow these instructions exactly, and prepare bottles and teats as directed. Don't ever change proportions of powder or water unless under medical advice.

 

Best Before Date (BBD) From: April 2027

withBbd.title: Anmum Gold NeoPro 2 Follow-on Formula Stage 2 900g X 6 Can (6-12 months)
withBbd.bodyHtml:
From 6 months, your baby is really starting to interact with the world – and they need the right amount and balance of nutrients to help support their growing bodies and minds in addition to the introduction of other foods. We’ve made Anmum NeoPro2 to help your baby head into this new phase.

Anmum NeoPro2 is formulated with a unique bundle of premium ingredients that support normal growth for babies aged 6-12 months.


Directions:
6-9 months: 200ml boiled water, 4 level scoops, 4 times per day

9-12 months: 200ml boiled water, 4 level scoops, 3-4 times per day


Ingredients:
Milk solids (Demineralised whey powder, Skim milk, Lactose), Vegetable oils (contains soy oil), Reduced fat cream powder, Fructo-oligosaccharides, Arachidonic acid (from M. Alpina oil), Docosahexaenoic acid (from C. Cohnii oil), Emulsifier (soy lecithin), Bifidobacterium lactis (DR10™), Taurine. Nucleotides: Adenosine 5’ monophosphate, Cytidine 5’ monophosphate, Guanosine 5’ monophosphate, Uridine 5’ monophosphate, Inosine 5’ monophosphate. Vitamins: Vitamins (A, B1, B2, B3, B5, B6, B12, C, E, D3, K1), ß-carotene, Biotin, Folic acid. Minerals: Calcium, Copper, Iron, Manganese, Magnesium, Potassium, Iodine, Sodium, Selenium, Zinc. Contains Milk and Soy.


Warnings:

Contains Milk and Soy.

Incorrect preparation of formula can make your baby very sick. Follow instructions on the tin exactly, and prepare bottles and teats as directed. Don't ever change proportions of powder unless under medical advice.

 

Best Before Date (BBD) From: March 2027

withBbd.title: Anmum Gold NeoPro 1 Infant Formula Stage 1 900g X 6 Can (0-6 months)
withBbd.bodyHtml:
Your little one needs a delicate balance of the right nutrients to help them stay healthy and grow. Anmum products have been carefully developed by Fonterra’s dedicated team of paediatric nutrition experts to make sure your little one gets a good start to life.

What is NeoPro1 doing for my baby?
Most of us can only imagine what’s going on as our baby develops. So Anmum NeoPro1 formula follows strict guidelines and food standards to make sure your baby is getting a good start to life.

0-6 months
There is no doubt about it – this is an incredible time in your baby’s development. We understand you want to be sure they’re getting the necessary support from their formula, so here’s some insight into Anmum NeoPro1.

Developed by those in the know.
Anmum NeoPro1 is formulated to include ingredients that support normal growth and development for babies aged 0-6 months.

 

Ingredients: Milk solids (Demineralised whey powder, Skim milk, Lactose, Whey protein concentrate), Vegetable oils (contains soy oil), Reduced fat cream powder, Arachidonic acid (from M. Alpina oil), Fructo-oligosaccharides, Docosahexaenoic acid (from C. Cohnii oil), Emulsifier (soy lecithin), Acidity regulators (citric acid, calcium hydroxide, potassium hydroxide), Bifidobacterium lactis (DR10™), Taurine, Inositol. Nucleotides: Adenosine 5’ monophosphate, Cytidine 5’ monophosphate, Guanosine 5’ monophosphate, Uridine 5’ monophosphate, Inosine 5’ monophosphate. Vitamins: Vitamins (A, B1, B2, B3, B5, B6, B12, C, E, D3, K1), ß-carotene, Biotin, Folic acid. Minerals: Calcium, Copper, Iron, Manganese, Magnesium, Potassium, Iodine, Sodium, Selenium, Zinc.

Dietary & Allergens: Contains Milk and Soy.

Probiotic DR10™, prebiotics, as well as essential vitamins and minerals, provide nutritional support for their active bodies and minds.

The role of a formulated supplementary food for young children is to supplement a normal eating plan to address situations where intakes of energy and nutrients may not be adequate to meet an individual’s requirements.
